messages:
ana (Docs): Drafting relnotes for 0.9.1 now. Focus: adaptive batching tweaks, KV-prefix cache behavior, and an opt-in quant toggle. I pushed the first draft to the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4612. Quick asks: 1) can someone validate the migration CLI snippet, 2) scan the SDK snippets for breaking changes, 3) call out any routing or Dedicated SLA caveats?

liam: Looking. Found a failing TS example in the chat streaming section that references `client.streamMessages` (old API). I'll swap to the new `chat.stream` pattern and add a tiny snippet. Also adding a note about how to opt out of new quant by pinning variants.

tara (PM): Add a 1-line customer-facing "known issue": "Some customers using very long context windows may see embedding score drift after recalibration." Include the short mitigation: "apply rolling-window rerank or shorten embedding window to <= 32k for now." Keep wording factual.

ci-bot: ci-bot: link-check started on branch relnotes/0.9.1 1 files to scan.

liam: Pushing the TS snippet in a sec. Snippet (compact):

```
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood();
for await (const chunk of client.chat.stream({ model: 'kestrel-v0.9.1', prompt: 'hello' })) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```

ana (Docs): (typo) small nit: we use lower-case "chat.stream" in docs copy. Also include a one-liner CLI migration command for ops teams:

```
redwood model variant-pin --id my-chat --variant kestrel-v0.9.1 --quant none
```

docs-reviewer: Two content bits: 1) If you mention Dedicated SLA, add parenthetical: "(latency SLOs apply only to Dedicated capacity)". 2) The relnotes currently say "improved embeddings accuracy" which is too vague for release notes; rewrite to "adjusted embedding calibration; may affect high-context similarity scores".

ci-bot: ci-bot: link-check finished: 12 OK, 2 redirects, 1 missing alt text (kernel-ops/fig2.png).

liam: I'll open a tiny PR to fix the image alt and the redirect to /docs/sdk/streams. I'll also add a redirect comment in the relnotes so customers know about the moved anchor.

ana (Docs): Perfect. Plan: freeze copy by 6pm PT, merge relnotes PR by EOD, schedule publish for 09:00 PT tomorrow. If anyone sees anything that reads like marketing-spin, mark it inline and I'll rewrite to technical tone. Thanks :sparkles:

ci-bot: ci-bot: tests passed on relnotes/0.9.1 branch.

liam: Quick follow-up: adding an inline example of attaching a KV-cache hint header for advanced users (single-line): `X-KV-Cache: prefix=customer-session-`

docs-reviewer: LGTM aside from the Dedicated SLA parenthetical and the embedding wording change. I'll leave a few inline suggestions in the PR.

ana (Docs): Acknowledged. Will resolve suggestions and merge after the image-alt PR lands.
